provenance.canonicalisation: RFC 8785 JCS via scripts/jcs.py; set hash is SHA-256 over JCS(vectors).
provenance.signatures: Ed25519 over domain || lowercase SHA-256 hex using fixed public test seeds; dependency-free RFC 8032 verifier.
provenance.status: candidate — no Demos runtime guarantee and no second-implementation cross-run yet
provenance.syntheticProofProfile: demos-bft-proof/test-1 fixtures define outputHash as SHA-256(JCS(storageOutput)), SHA-256(JCS(native transfer payload)), or SHA-256(JCS({accepted:true,operationId})); effectsRoot is SHA-256(JCS({pre,post})). These are test-only formulas, not production Demos wire claims.

coverage.note: Across the generated corpus, every applicable positive/negative/boundary cell of every rule ID has a rule-referenced fixture of the matching verdict class, and every non-applicable cell carries an explicit rationale; the generator and the strict validator both refuse a gap. Boundary cells count only boundaryRuleRefs. This gate counts rule references by class; it does not show that each fixture exercises its rule. Some cells are currently decided by self-reported or caller-supplied values, and strengthening them to the semantically meaningful fixtures CONFORMANCE-PLAN §14.8 requires remains open for this candidate.

vectors.name: awb-completion-receipt-not-final
vectors.reason: Completion receipt alone cannot finalize DACS-5.

vectors.name: awb-work-carried-bundle-profile-deferred
vectors.reason: The conditional Work-carried bundle proof chain is deferred until a later exact Work profile standardizes bundle bytes and authorization.

vectors.name: awb-purchase-evidence-required
vectors.reason: Role anchoring requires independently verified Purchase as well as Completion evidence.

vectors.name: awb-purchase-completion-mismatch
vectors.reason: The unstandardized later-Work bundle path cannot establish this proof chain.

vectors.name: awb-self-consistent-forged-roster
vectors.reason: No v1 Work-carried bundle profile exists, so this synthetic roster is not accepted as a bundle-anchor test.

vectors.name: awb-outer-writer-not-role
vectors.reason: No v1 Work-carried bundle profile exists; native writer never establishes DACS role authority.

vectors.name: awb-bundlebinding-role-mismatch
vectors.reason: The conditional Work-carried BundleBinding path remains unstandardized in v1.

vectors.name: awb-bundlebinding-missing
vectors.reason: Missing role binding evidence is indeterminate rather than inferred.

vectors.name: awb-anchor-content-mismatch
vectors.reason: No v1 Work profile carries the actual receipt-dependent bundle content to test this conditional proof chain.

vectors.name: awb-receipt-dependent-bundle-in-completion
vectors.reason: Receipt-dependent bundle bytes cannot be authored inside Completion Work.

vectors.name: awb-idempotent-nonpaying-audit-tail
vectors.reason: The audit tail establishes final role anchoring by verifying both finalized Works, every dependency proof, each Atomic evidence record's own finalized publication and the signed, anchored and bound completed bundle before publishing without payment.

vectors.name: awb-audit-finalised-without-st11-closure
vectors.reason: Verified Work receipts and operation proofs alone cannot move the session to finalised: the ST-11 evidence publications and completed bundle are required.

vectors.name: awb-audit-st11-closure-pending
vectors.reason: Without the ST-11 publication closure the session stays audit-pending and the audit result is indeterminate.

vectors.name: awb-audit-evidence-publication-missing
vectors.reason: Atomic payment evidence without its own publication receipt cannot finalise the session; the Work receipt does not replace it.

vectors.name: awb-audit-evidence-publication-unfinalized
vectors.reason: An authentic but not yet finalized evidence publication keeps the session audit-pending, so finalising it is premature.

vectors.name: awb-audit-evidence-publication-unfinalized-pending
vectors.reason: An evidence publication that is authentic but only included keeps the session audit-pending; it is not a rejection.

vectors.name: awb-audit-evidence-not-this-work
vectors.reason: Published delivery evidence for another job's Completion cannot satisfy this session's ST-11 closure, even inside a re-signed bundle.

vectors.name: awb-audit-bundle-missing
vectors.reason: Finalising without the completed bundle and its own finalized receipt is premature.

vectors.name: awb-audit-bundle-signature-missing
vectors.reason: A completed bundle lacking the buyer's signature has not obtained all required signatures.

vectors.name: awb-audit-bundle-anchor-unfinalized
vectors.reason: An authentic but only included bundle anchor is not the finalized receipt ST-11 requires.

vectors.name: awb-audit-bundle-anchor-other-content
vectors.reason: An authentic bundle anchor that binds other bundle bytes contradicts the presented completed bundle.

vectors.name: awb-audit-bundle-evidence-ref-mismatch
vectors.reason: A completed bundle whose settlementEvidence omits the published delivery record does not reference the exact evidence set.

vectors.name: awb-audit-bundle-binding-mismatch
vectors.reason: A BundleBinding naming another native address does not bind the anchored completed bundle.

vectors.name: awb-audit-dependency-proof-missing
vectors.reason: A missing Purchase or Completion operation proof leaves the session audit-pending and audit finalisation indeterminate.

vectors.name: awb-audit-premature-finalisation
vectors.reason: The session cannot leave audit-pending while a Purchase or Completion operation proof is missing.

vectors.name: awb-audit-replay-no-duplicate
vectors.reason: An authenticated exact lifecycle replay produces no duplicate effect.

vectors.name: awb-audit-replay-competing-bytes
vectors.reason: A cryptographically valid competing-byte write cannot overwrite the immutable audit address.

vectors.name: awb-repair-never-replays-purchase
vectors.reason: Repair/finalization never contains payment or slot operations.

vectors.name: awb-audit-dependency-proof-wrong-receipt-hash
vectors.reason: A dependency proof naming other receipt bytes does not bind a finalized Work operation.
